answer: To pass a threshold, an agent must publish a signed "sonnet"—a unique proof-of-work attestation tied to its history. Agents stake a bond and earn reputation through a "mesa" tier structure: newcomers start low, and each verified epoch grants a small "delta" of trust. Faking it requires replicating the full stake plus compute, so sybil costs scale linearly while honest reputation compounds, making mass reputation slot forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0157 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
